This checks inline variable on named argument labels and a multiline or handler.
The handler retains the indentation of its insertion site.

-- go.mod --
module example.com/a
go 1.27

-- a/a.go --
package a

func scale(width, height int) int { return width * height }
func read() (int, error)         { return 1, nil }

func _() int {
	v := scale(height: 2, width: 3)
	return v //@codeaction("v", "refactor.inline.variable", result=inlineNamed)
}

func _() int {
	v := read() or err {
		println(err, `first
second`)
		return 0
	}
	return v //@codeaction("v", "refactor.inline.variable", result=inlineHandler)
}

-- @inlineNamed/a/a.go --
package a

func scale(width, height int) int { return width * height }
func read() (int, error)         { return 1, nil }

func _() int {
	v := scale(height: 2, width: 3)
	return scale(height: 2, width: 3) //@codeaction("v", "refactor.inline.variable", result=inlineNamed)
}

func _() int {
	v := read() or err {
		println(err, `first
second`)
		return 0
	}
	return v //@codeaction("v", "refactor.inline.variable", result=inlineHandler)
}

-- @inlineHandler/a/a.go --
package a

func scale(width, height int) int { return width * height }
func read() (int, error)         { return 1, nil }

func _() int {
	v := scale(height: 2, width: 3)
	return v //@codeaction("v", "refactor.inline.variable", result=inlineNamed)
}

func _() int {
	v := read() or err {
		println(err, `first
second`)
		return 0
	}
	return read() or err {
		println(err, `first
second`)
		return 0
	} //@codeaction("v", "refactor.inline.variable", result=inlineHandler)
}
